heading: Simple Origami Penguin for Beginners
introduction: Follow the diagram and written steps below to fold your very own origami penguin. All you need is one square sheet of paper — no scissors, no glue!
durationNote: Planning estimate; allow extra time for your first attempt.
paper: One square sheet of thin origami paper, about 15 × 15 cm (6 × 6 in).

steps.title: Start with a Square Sheet
steps.text: Use a square piece of origami paper. If your paper is two-toned, start with the darker colour facing down — this will become the penguin's back.

steps.title: Fold in Half Diagonally
steps.text: Bring one corner up to meet the opposite corner, forming a triangle. Crease firmly along the fold, then unfold back to a flat square.

steps.title: Unfold
steps.text: Open the paper back out flat. You now have a diagonal crease running corner to corner.

steps.title: Fold Both Sides to the Centre Crease
steps.text: Fold the left and right corners inward so their edges meet along the diagonal crease in the centre. You should now have a kite shape.

steps.title: Fold the Bottom Point Up
steps.text: Take the bottom pointed tip and fold it upward so it meets roughly the centre of the shape. This creates the penguin's white belly area.

steps.title: Fold Up the Smaller Triangle
steps.text: Fold the small triangle at the top downward slightly — this will become the penguin's head. Leave a small white strip showing at the top for the face.

steps.title: Fold the Entire Shape in Half
steps.text: Fold the whole shape in half vertically (mountain fold), bringing the right side behind the left. The penguin's body shape should now be visible from the side.

steps.title: Fold the Head Back at an Angle
steps.text: Rotate the top portion (the head) forward at a slight angle using an inside reverse fold. This gives the penguin its characteristic tilted head and creates the beak.

steps.title: Fold the Base Flaps Down (Wings)
steps.text: On each side, fold the bottom corner flaps downward and outward to form the penguin's flippers/wings. Crease well so they hold their shape.

steps.title: Your Penguin is Complete!
steps.text: Stand your penguin upright. Give it a gentle squeeze at the base to help it balance. Add a dot with a pen for the eye and your origami penguin is done!

tips: Line up corners before pressing a crease from the middle outwards.
Keep the paper facing the same way as the instruction before each fold.
commonMistakes: If layers do not line up, return to the last clear step rather than forcing the next fold.
Thick paper becomes difficult to fold as layers build up; try a larger, thinner square.
